reviews.review:
This review is written mainly as an advisory point and is not an attempt at undermining the hard work put into this game.

That said.. Game Grumps are awful hosts, and the controversy that surrounds this games production is just so insane. The hard work put into it just to be minimally appreciated and shadowed 24/7 is just.. ugh! Not even minimally appreciated, it just WASN'T appreciated. I can't recommend this game in good conscious for the sake of not sending more cash these guys' way.

On another note, the game itself is great. These characters have amazing arcs, and it is so hard to fall in love with only one of them. Plus the balance of being a dad and a widower while trying to slip into the dating game is handled very well. Main game complaint is the golf mini-game sucks and is infuriating.. Had to get a friend to do it and it took him a rough day or two. Another thing that sucks by a mile is the character creator.. You get all these fine SOBs and then there's just you looking out of place. Aside from that, great game, awful devs/publisher, mediocre flaws.
